reviews.review:
I liked it. It's not as groundbreaking as the trilogy of course, but it's pretty alright.
It didn't make me feel the emotions that the trilogy made me feel, but idk I still think the story is alright.

It had several decisions which seemed very relevant, but didn't matter for the game's ending. I think those might've been fleshed out in later games. Just like how some ME1 decisions only bit you in the ass in ME3. But who knows. I sure don't.

And even if you are already sure that you hate the story with a burning passion, then the gameplay is pretty good for the eight whole euros you have to pay when the game is on sale. Just buy it and have something to shoot ♥♥♥♥ in while listening to music idk. The whole selecting powers based on what you currently think works best in your situation while sprinting and jump-jetting all over the place was very fun.

The whole gameplay loop feels like any other game from right around 2016 though. You have your strike teams, several open world maps and your resource collecting and weapon and armor researching. Aka this and MGS:V are largely the same game but in a different setting, really. If you're alright with one, you'll be fine with the other probably.

Was deciding between this and the Legendary Collection which comprises of all 3 of the previous games. Have not progressed far nor finished Andromeda so I decided on this. Wanted to support one of my favorite franchises. Good buy if it's on sale! 

PS Each time I come back to this game I see new improvements and tweaks. Really love it and hope I get to finish it this time around!

Well... I have to admit, the crowd mentality got to me on this game. I didn't buy it until today during an 80% off sale. What a mistake ! This game is really good and all the bad stuff that was said about was probably when it launched. It runs great, looks spectacular, and the combat is just plain awesome ! The thing is, I'm not that kind of person. If everyone goes right, I turn left. (always) But each time this game came up, everything I saw or read was bad. It's just not true !

About the only thing I might agree with is that it doesn't "follow" like a normal sequel. But it's not made too. (it's in the name) It's 600 years later in the Andromeda galaxy. Please don't do like I did. Give this game a chance. Play it for an hour and if it's not your thing, get a refund. But I can almost guarantee, if you don't like it, it won't be because of the things you've heard. It's a great game and an absolute steal if you get it on sale.

Thank you for taking the time to read this friend. Have a good one !   ~Mu
